scope: Read-only existing-session GETs and direct ReplayService.view calls. No order, provider, broker or user-session writes. Command transport persists GET receipts as its normal implementation.

runtime.api: Rust Axum loopback 8010 with Python domain-command workers

baseline_service_profile.conclusion: Full-file checksum verification dominates even a small read of the replay state.

alternating_direct_service_comparison.method: Warm up the same service once. Alternate uncached/cached ordering on six rounds. Clear only the verification receipt map before each uncached sample; both variants read identical data and return value-equal payloads. No profiling in this comparison.
alternating_direct_service_comparison.limit: Diagnostic service microbenchmark, not a whole-UI latency or stable tail benchmark. First cold access still verifies the full artifact.

after_managed_restart_http_ms.limit: The first 6428 sample includes cold verification. Root performed the managed restart. These are GET samples; no mutation was issued against either existing owner session.

historical_command_receipts_ms.source: Read-only SELECT of recent completed owner replay commands, not new order benchmarks.
historical_command_receipts_ms.limit: Commands occurred before this task; differing payloads/operations mean they are context rather than a paired before/after mutation comparison.

remaining_source_costs.notes: Polling was unchanged. UI used to wait for the authoritative response before showing any order line; pending UI feedback is a separate frontend change.

covered_integrity_cases: replacement with original size and mtime
